first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A man wearing reddish-brown glasses, a dark suit jacket, and a white shirt, holding handgun A; the face is noticeably out of focus in this clip.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A man with short dark hair and narrow dark glasses, wearing a long black coat, a dark close-fitting top, and trousers, with wide straps and metal buckles at the waist and legs.

entities.name: handgun A
entities.identification: The black handgun held by Person A and pointed toward the camera, with a circular muzzle, slide, and top front sight visible at the front.

entities.name: glass-curtain-wall high-rise
entities.identification: The blue-gray reflective glass-curtain-wall high-rise occupying most of the background in the final shot, with broad light-colored vertical columns and rectangular divisions on its facade.

entities.name: brown rooftop equipment structure
entities.identification: The tall, dark brown rectangular structure on the image-left side of the first shot, with horizontal and vertical divisions and mottled marks on its surface, and a vertical metal pipe connected to its image-right edge.

entities.name: muzzle flash
entities.identification: The bright white-yellow flash covering most of the image when handgun A fires.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: A flat gray-brown rooftop surface divided into large slab-like areas by straight seams.

entities.name: low rooftop wall
entities.identification: The low light gray-beige walls distributed along the far edge and both sides of the rooftop, with two sloped supports beside the wall on the image-left side.

entities.name: rooftop metal railing
entities.identification: The railing on the image-right side of the final shot, extending along the rooftop edge and composed of thin gray horizontal rails and vertical posts.

entities.name: smoke
entities.identification: The white-gray smoke spanning both sides of Person B in the first shot, with dense clusters and thin translucent layers.

entities.name: distant city buildings
entities.identification: The collection of distant city buildings in the first shot, as well as the distant building partially exposed on the image-right side of the glass-curtain-wall high-rise in the final shot.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The bright light gray-blue background area above or beside the buildings.

entities.name: gray muzzle smoke
entities.identification: The light gray, translucent, diffuse layer of smoke that appears after the muzzle flash fades.
